title: The task's promised free 'weigh the writ against the stair' entry could not be found anywhere in Coldpass despite thorough exploration (Watch Checkpoint, Coldpass South Stair with Sergeant Bray both before and after obtaining the writ, St. Ashwyn's Perch courtyard/guesthouse/scriptorium/pilgrims' hall/bell tower, and the Pass Gate). Only 'show the Regent's writ at the gate' existed as an action; the closest substitute was Abbot Corvin's spoken line 'The writ's fastest, and costs what you won't see billed.'
